evidence: Official Purdue GIS FID 780 labels the feature Sigma Kappa (SOSK) at 427 Russell St.
The 2023 Beta Sigma newsletter says 427 Russell Street is the chapter house; Purdue Panhellenic identifies Sigma Kappa as Beta Sigma.
Fresh Blender probe matched 21/21 unique GIS vertices; maximum base residual 0.00001469 m.
findings: The campus GIS has no published positional accuracy and is not a certified survey.

evidence: Structural wall base reproduces the GIS campus coordinates and the object transform is identity.
The evaluated bounds extend about 3.34 m west of the GIS wall boundary, attributable to the front portico/steps; eaves extend only about 0.22 m.
findings: The house illustration is not georeferenced, so its facade bearing toward Russell Street is plausible but not verified.
No measured source independently validates the overall building height or roof envelope.

evidence: The artist illustration supports the broad two-story silhouette, twin front gables, central dormers, and chimney.
Modeled eaves are 7.15 m, gable ridge 11.65 m, chimney top 15.3 m; all are stated as estimates.
findings: GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with the two exterior stories shown in the illustration, and its field definition is unpublished.
GIS Extrution=12 has no documented units or semantics; no measured elevations were found.
The source is a stylized illustration, not a measured elevation or photograph; roof intersections and exact dimensions remain unverified.

evidence: The model visibly includes red-brick wings, twin gables, centered columned portico and pediment, repeated windows, dormers, and a chimney matching the saved Sigma Kappa house illustration.
A fresh visual comparison of the rendered preview and illustration supports the main facade composition.
findings: Window groupings and portico proportions are simplified; the illustration does not establish measured dimensions or bearing.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: The .blend reopens in Blender 5.2.3 LTS with the expected collection and one House_301840869 mesh; no camera or light objects remain.
The object has identity transform, 3589 vertices, 849 faces, and no external image dependencies.
Building-specific source snapshots, structured evidence, validation output, preview, and evaluator artifacts are present.
